reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Arco Design Vue (https://arco.design/vue/en-US/docs/start).
Technology stack: vue, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 页面顶部是一条蓝色中文横幅，写 Arco Toolbox Figma 插件工具全新发布，有奖公测中~，右侧统一导航是 Design / Development / Ecosystem 三个下拉加 English 切换、明暗切换和 GitHub 图标。左栏最上面并排 React 和 Vue 两个 tab，Vue 亮着；下面分 Developer Guide（Quick Start、Dark Mode、Custom Theme、Design Token、Internationalization、FAQ、Changelog）和 Arco Pro（Quick start、Npm Scripts、Directory、Layout、Routes and menu、Permission Control、State management - Pinia）两段。主区标题 Getting Started，紧跟一句 Auto translate by google.，Vue Version 一节要求 vue 大于等于 3.2.0 并注明 Vue3 不支持 IE，Install 一节给 npm 与 yarn 两行命令，Full import 一节再给完整的 import 片段。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
